title: Cut-off pull-back of test forms along the coordinate projection ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ^P: agreement near a compact set, exterior derivative, support, norm bound and continuity (parent steps 4, 5(b), 8, 9)
statement: Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d] (Mathlib's normalized Euclidean Hausdorff measure). For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω), d = exteriorDerivative); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm: |α|² = Σ_I α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(d−1)})² over strictly increasing I); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 denotes the standard basis vector of the respective space; castSucc : Fin P → Fin (P + 1) and last = Fin.last P. Let P, d ∈ ℕ and let p : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ^P be a continuous linear map with (py)_i = y_{castSucc i} for every y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} and i ∈ Fin P (the orthogonal projection forgetting the last coordinate). For a d-form ω on ℝ^P write p^#ω(y) := ω(py)(p·, …, p·) = (ω(py)).compContinuousLinearMap p. Then for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^{P+1} there are an open set V ⊇ K and a linear map E : 𝒟^d(ℝ^P) → 𝒟^d(ℝ^{P+1}) (domains univ) such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(ℝ^P): (i) E(ω)(y) = p^#ω(y) for every y ∈ V; (ii) (dE(ω))(y) = (dω)(py)(p·, …, p·) for every y ∈ V; (iii) tsupport E(ω) ⊆ p⁻¹(tsupport ω); (iv) |E(ω)(y)| ≤ |ω(py)| for every y (Euclidean coefficient norms); and (v) E is sequentially continuous at 0: if ω_j → 0 in 𝒟^d(ℝ^P) in the sense of TestFormOnConverges (all supports in one compact set, every iterated derivative converging uniformly there), then E(ω_j) → 0 in 𝒟^d(ℝ^{P+1}) in the same sense.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (p : Euclid (P + 1) →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ (y : Euclid (P + 1)) (i : Fin P), p y i = y (Fin.castSucc i)) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid (P + 1)), IsCompact K → ∃ (V : Set (Euclid (P + 1))) (E : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d →ₗ[ℝ] TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (P + 1))) d), IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), y ∈ V → (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y)).compContinuousLinearMap p) ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), y ∈ V → exteriorDerivative (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y)).compContinuousLinearMap p) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, tsupport (E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) ⊆ p ⁻¹' tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d)) ∧ (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (y : Euclid (P + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm ((E ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (P + 1)) d) y) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) (p y))) ∧ ∀ ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → TestFormOnConverges (fun j => E (ωs j)) 0
